The '''Second Birth''' was an event in [[Yevetha]] history, from after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] left [[N'zoth]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].

Prior to the Empire's arrival, the Yevetha had settled [[The Twelve|eleven colony worlds]] using slower than light technology. After the Empire's withdrawal, the Yevetha were left with [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and [[Hypercomm/Legends|hypercomm]] technology. This enabled them to engage in the Second Birth, in which they rapidly colonized an additional dozen worlds.
